prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the pigment container from material station to mobile robot platform.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: material station
What the inspection checks: Check whether the pigment container is on material station.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: A tiered aluminium rack/shelving unit holds rows of white label holders, each with a purple icon block, a small hazard-style pictogram and bilingual text (Chinese plus names such as "Ecoflex 0050-B", "Dragon skin 30 A/B", "Sylgard DC184 A/B", "Sorta Clear 40 A", "Si-Pigment Brown", "Si-Pigment Black", "YMM-15-7", "YMM-7-4", "Mold 1–4"). Roughly four horizontal rows of labels are visible on the angled rack face. On the top surface, at left, sit clear/translucent flat trays or containers. In the lower centre, in front of a label, stands one small upright bottle with a white cap and a dark teal/blue-green body, apparently holding dark liquid. Background: plain white wall, dark metal frame upper right.
observations: The description mentions only one small bottle on the rack, making it impossible to confirm if the specific pigment container required for the workflow step is present.
